Order decides it, not band. THE INSTRUMENT LESSON: because all legs share one account, XP is NOT comparable across legs of the same lesson, and no finding may be built on that comparison. I built one on a verifier's aside without checking the mechanism; a re-cite agent checked it and refuted it.
